biggest_catch: Your friend must be a NEW member (no Desert Financial accounts in the last 12 months), open a Membership Savings with $25 minimum plus a free checking account, and within 90 days receive at least one direct deposit AND post at least 30 checking transactions - only then does your $100 arrive, deposited no later than 10 business days in the month following the end of the 90-day qualification period.
catches: Friend must be a new member with no existing or open DFCU accounts in the last 12 months; must open Membership Savings ($25 minimum) and a qualified free checking account.
Within 90 calendar days of opening, the friend must have at least 30 posted transactions in the new checking account and receive a qualifying direct deposit (as determined by DFCU).
Friend must be 18+ with a valid U.S. Taxpayer Identification Number or SSN; membership eligibility required.
Referring member must be 18+ and be the primary owner of an open and active Membership Savings opened before the friend's account opening date.

Ineligible as referrer: existing joint account owners, primary owners who closed membership within the past 12 months, DFCU employees (including subsidiaries/affiliates/agencies) and their immediate family.
The referrer and friend may not begin credit union membership on the same day.
Accounts must be open and not delinquent more than 30 days at bonus time; bonus paid to the referrer's Membership Savings and the friend's qualifying checking.
Bonus subject to taxes and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
No stated cap on the number of referrals; may not be combined with other account-opening offers; subject to change without notice.

steps: Log in to Desert Financial Online Banking, click 'Refer someone', and fill out the form to send your friend an invite (or print the referral form for a branch visit).
Friend opens a Membership Savings ($25 minimum) and a free checking account via the referral email link, by phone, or with the completed form at a branch.
Within 90 days, the friend receives at least one direct deposit and posts at least 30 checking transactions.
Your $100 bonus is deposited to your Membership Savings no later than 10 business days in the month following the end of the 90-day qualification period.
timing: Bonus deposited to the referring member's Membership Savings no later than 10 business days in the month following the end of the 90-day qualification period.
